CHOLECYSTITIS.title: Cholecystitis (inflamed gallbladder)

items: Cholecystitis is inflammation of the gallbladder, a small organ under the liver that stores bile.
Most cases are caused by gallstones.
Pain in the upper right belly that lasts more than about 5 to 6 hours.
Fever, nausea or vomiting, and tenderness when the upper right belly is pressed while breathing in.
Ultrasound of the belly, the first test. It usually shows gallstones.
Blood tests including a blood count, liver tests, and lipase.
Blood cultures if you are very unwell.
Your doctor will decide between antibiotics, pain relief, and surgery to remove the gallbladder.

sections.h: What you can do at home
items: Ask your doctor about diet while the pain is active.
Tell your doctor about any past attacks of gallbladder pain.
Your team will advise on surgery and check your recovery.
This leaflet gives general information. Follow your doctor's advice.

urgent: Pain that is severe and does not settle
Fever with yellow skin, or with confusion
Low blood pressure or feeling faint
